signature.name: National Palace of Culture, Guatemala City
signature.detail: The grand green-tiled presidential palace on the Plaza de la Constitución is the city's civic icon, with murals and ceremonial halls worth a look. Go on a weekday morning when guided interior visits are most reliable, and bring photo ID for security.

signature.name: Metropolitan Cathedral of Guatemala City
signature.detail: The twin-towered cathedral anchors the historic center and shelters colonial-era art and crypts. Visit early in the day to avoid crowds and dress modestly, as it is an active church.

signature.name: Plaza de la Constitución
signature.detail: This broad central square links the palace and cathedral and is the best starting point for a walk through Zona 1. Come in the morning or late afternoon for cooler weather and livelier street life.

signature.name: Zona 1 historic center
signature.detail: The old grid of streets holds the city's main monuments, markets and faded grandeur, best explored on foot. A weekday stroll with a map or guide is the safest and most rewarding way to see it.

signature.name: Kaminaljuyu
signature.detail: One of the few visible remnants of the ancient Maya city beneath modern Guatemala City, with grassy mounds and a small site museum. Go in the morning; it is a short taxi ride from the center and rarely crowded.

signature.name: Museo Nacional de Arqueología y Etnología
signature.detail: The country's premier collection of Maya artifacts and regional ethnography, essential context before visiting Tikal or Antigua. Allow two hours; it is closed on Mondays, so check hours before you go.

signature.name: Popol Vuh Museum
signature.detail: A compact but superb private collection of Maya ceramics and sculpture housed at a university. It is quiet on weekdays and pairs well with a visit to the nearby zoo area.

signature.name: La Aurora Zoo
signature.detail: A large, well-kept city zoo with regional wildlife and family-friendly paths, popular with locals on weekends. Arrive at opening to see animals active and avoid midday heat.

transport: Taxi or ride-hail across Zona 1 $4-8; city bus under $1
